reviews.text:
Good vets at this office.

One serious complaint: the quality of the front desk’s bookkeeping has been lacking on several occasions, causing confusion, split / incomplete records, less continuity of care, etc.  They need to finally figure that out, because it appears to be a long term problem.

I returned to Culver Palms after not having been here in over three years, and unfortunately, I will not be returning.

I have Pet Assure, and when I called about a week before my appointment, I was told my appointment would be around $160 total. However, after meeting with Dr. Ram, I was presented with proposed services totaling over $1,000. I declined the numerous additional services that were recommended.

My experience with Dr. Ram was also extremely unpleasant. He repeatedly talked over me and was incredibly condescending and aggressive in the way he communicated with me. I found his behavior disrespectful and completely unacceptable for a veterinarian speaking with a pet owner who is simply trying to understand their pet’s care.

Most concerning to me was the billing and my Pet Assure discount. If you have Pet Assure, I strongly recommend carefully checking the original price of every service against the supposedly discounted price before paying. Based on the paperwork I was shown, there were instances where a price appeared to be presented as though a Pet Assure discount had been applied, but when I compared the numbers, it appeared I was actually being charged the original price. That made me seriously question how the discount was being calculated and represented.

Please call ahead, ask for prices in writing if possible, and if you have Pet Assure, do the math yourself before paying your bill.

It’s a shame because the women at the front desk were genuinely very nice and helpful. Unfortunately, my experience with Dr. Ram, combined with my concerns about the billing and application of the Pet Assure discount, is why I will not return.
They're pretty accommodating. The staff is always very nice and accommodating. There prices are in the normal range.

The receptionist is insanely rude, not sure how she got hired in the first place.

Not to mention the doctor is not good with little dogs. My chihuahua loves humans, but the vet was not good with him and he just barked and barked at him. My dog has only ever barked at homeless people....

Don't waste your time. Its overpriced and the people suck.
Great service, comparatively reasonable prices for the area

Never take your pet to this place! I was proscribed ear medication for my dogs ear infection from the veterinarian. That medication made my dog go deaf. They had no idea what happened or what went wrong. I was told to wait and they'll call me with more information. 2 1/2 weeks went by before I heard anything from them. I called multiple times to get information about what the next step is. By call #3 I was already pretty upset about being left in the dark without any information. I may have been a little stern but respectful in what I said but the Vet techs took it as disrespect and with that being said the Veterinarian decided to withhold information Regarding on what the next steps should be for my dog. Completely unacceptable and unprofessional! the Vet techs are completely incompetent it's a horrible place to take your dog! Find someone else!!

Dr. Bernstrom (sp) has been my primary vet for years. When my last dog passed, I brought my new dog to him. Although for urgent issues, I will see other vets. They are generally able to get me in quickly. I find the prices reasonable for the area. In the years I have been going, I have had minimal issues. The staff is friendly. The office is clean. The vets are compassionate with me and my pet.

Mr. Tony and all of the Animal Doctors, and staff,  thank you for taking care of our Shiba Inu , Mochi!!
All the best, stay healthy!

Exceptionally kind, considerate and efficient team. The vets and staff clearly love animals and work well together. Excellent communication between front and back of the practice- we knew immediately when our pets were finished with the techs, our pets were brought out by caring staff and we were checked out quickly. Cats remained relaxed throughout, even the crazy one ;)  Huge difference between CPAH and other more corporate-feeling franchise practices. Amazing!

RUDE front office staff! Please spend some time training and supervising your front desk staff because they are not helpful or pleasant. Looking at your reviews this seems like a pattern and recurring issue…
On the flip side your vet techs are great 🤩
I called for a nail trim for my elderly chihuahua last minute on Saturday. They fit me in no problem, The tech was very kind and did a great nail trim.

Truly outstanding vet, every single step of my experience over the years here have been consistently so good. The techs are knowledgeable, thoughtful, sensitive and punctual. Very professional and truly exceptional care for each and every creature who comes through their doors.

I’ve had good experiences here so far with my cats but please I urge you guys to get rid of those scented candles that are permeating the entire waiting room! It’s so strong and awful! Not good to be breathing this in for humans OR pets. I leave here my clothes completely drenched with this smell it’s awful.

I am deeply disappointed with my recent experience. I have been a loyal client of this practice for over 20 years, entrusting them with the care of my pets. When it came time to make the difficult decision to euthanize my 15-year-old pet, I was quoted approximately $600 for euthanasia and cremation services. Due to the cost, I was forced to seek care at a different nearby veterinary clinic during an already emotional time and paid half the cost for the same services.

Additionally, I have experienced ongoing concerns with the front office, particularly regarding organization and scheduling efficiency.

I reached out via email on April 21, 2026, to address these concerns and included both the office manager, Justin, and the owner, Tony. Unfortunately, I have not received any response. The lack of follow-up, especially after many years of loyalty, has been very disappointing. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend this business.

Rude!! The receptionist Tom had a terrible attitude. After being confused because my dog had a prescription for Bravecto that was previously approved and suddenly declined. Instead of politely  addressing my concerns since I found the new visit being unnecessary, I was met with a cold dismissive attitude. Having a bad disposition dealing with the public should not be acceptable. I do not know who pissed in his coffee this morning, but he is the reason I will not be returning for service.

Everyone is really kind from the person who answers the call to the vet. Pet desk is awesome and makes appointments, refills, general questions quick. The hours are large which makes accessing care a lot easier. Our dog is nervous but does seem a lot less than other vet offices.
Like the doctors and the staff. Don't like much the fact that you have to pay a deposit of almost $90 when you book the appointment. :(

Dr.Sheriff was very caring, she was checking my cat Luna!
Luna is a senior cat, she lost some weight recently and she was not feeling well. Doctor and her assistant did a great job looking after Luna, they took her to the lab inside in the hospital for blood work and urine test.
The entire process was very quick: I had the appointment in time, full checkup on my kitty was done as much as needed, and the blood work took only 20-30 minutes.
They gave Luna 🐈‍⬛  for home pain medicine for 7 days, she’s taking it as needed; they gave her a hydration boost at the lab, also some great wet can food for senior cats to take home. Luna liked it, and she began eating it right away once we were back home. Also doctor gave her appetite stimulants for 5-7 days, and it helps my pet. I see that she began eating a little more.

We’re still waiting on her blood work results, but I hope Luna will get better, and will heal soon 🙏🏻

Thank you so much Dr.Sheriff and all the personnel for being very caring, professional and helpful ❤️‍🩹🐈‍⬛😻

I have been bringing my dog here since I moved to Palms over 3 years ago, and they always take such great care of her. Whether it's a routine check up or a last minute appointment/emergency, the team at Culver Palms Animal Hospital takes the best care of our pup. If you're looking for a vet in the area, I highly recommend them!! They truly care about and love your pets, they provide thorough and thoughtful care, and they clearly communicate all costs and expectations up front. Could not ask for more!

I owe a life long debt of gratitude to the Doctors and Techs who took such amazing care of my dog, Stanley, who was on the verge of a major crisis.  Their kindness and keen senses got us right away to the next step on his journey.  He is alive today, in part due to Culver Palms Animal Hospital and their seamless handoff to the critical care and ICU services at Access.  Special thanks to Dr. Scott Palmer and those who assisted him.
Best to take your pet somewhere else, so many better options for your animals in the area.

We really appreciate the attention and love Beave receives whenever we come in. Also, from the front to the back ( Katie ❤️) and Dr. B, we respect the on going advice you have given us since our labradoodle was 12 weeks old to 18mths old. We hope to have many more healthy years of visits! We highly recommend Culver palms animal hospital to new and older fur parents.
I brought my cats here multiple times and my experience was great everytime. I highly recommend this place to any pet owner.

Truly the best. The CPAH team from their techs, front desk, to veterinarians are so thoughtful and loving with our pup Cosmo. He has had some health issues and they have helped us navigate them with such grace and caught a very crucial issue that we needed to address with specialists. Their attentiveness and kindness is SO SO appreciated. Thank you for everything CPAH, Team.

I brought my two sick dogs to this clinic and was extremely disappointed with the experience from beginning to end. The front desk staff seemed indifferent—not just toward me, but also toward my dogs and their own responsibilities. When I called with concerns, I was met with unhelpful and dismissive responses that only added to my stress.

During the appointment, I couldn't shake the feeling that I was being taken advantage of. What should have been a straightforward visit turned into a 2-hour ordeal as they continuously came out with additional "recommended" tests and medications, inflating the cost without clear explanations.

Based on my experience, I will not be returning. I'm genuinely surprised by the clinic’s high rating—it doesn't reflect the service I received. Makes me question the authenticity of the reviews.

I went with this vet because it was the nearest vet that took my dogs pet insurance. However, come to find out, when my dog was seriously sick, they do not take walkins. Do NOT put this vet within your pet insurance because this vet is not reliable for emergencies. My dog was going to this vet for >3 years. When he was sick, pooping blood, severe vomiting, and trembling, upon arrival the reception said “we don’t take walkins” and gave addresses for the nearest ER vets. Looking at the appointment list at the desk, everyone had appointments for nail trims & physicals. This vet does not prioritize your dogs health when it matters most. Would give it 0 stars if I could.
It’s fine- definitely feels like a business more than animal care, but they are friendly and get the job done.

I’ve been taking my dog to this clinic for about a year and a half and have mixed feelings. We’ve generally had a very good experience with the vets. The office staff, however, leave something to be desired. Most of the staff are friendly and want to be helpful however they tend to be inconsistent and seem a little inexperienced.

I’m almost always placed on hold when I call, even though there’s generally 3-4 staff working the front desk and rarely that many people demanding their attention at once. Today I actually called ahead of my appt to let them know I was running late. They put me on hold for 6 minutes during which time I arrived at the clinic and walked in to a completely empty waiting room and 3 staff members sitting quietly at the front.

Wait times at the clinic are definitely on the longer side. We’re usually seen 15-20+ min after our appt time, even for vet tech appts.

On 2 separate occasions I’ve been given flea/heartworm meds that would expire before the 6 months in which my dog would use them. Both times I caught the mistake and to my surprise was told they did not have a non expired med in stock.

Last summer when my dog was seen for his annual they were out of bordatella vaccines so we had to schedule a separate appt and come back to get it.

The staff is also not the best at checking for upcoming vaccines/testing that are due. Today I brought my dog for vaccines but it wasn’t until after I left the office that I received a notification that he was also due for heartworm testing. This is not the first time this has happened and when I called the office for clarification I had a particularly frustrating conversation with Tom who very matter of factly told me he offered the testing (he had not), blamed me for the mix up, and then hung up the phone without saying goodbye.

Needless to say I feel very conflicted about staying at this clinic. The vets and the convenience of having this place in my neighborhood is what’s kept me here thus far but there’s certainly quite a bit of room for improvement.

I recently moved from the valley and had to leave my wonderful vet behind. My partner recommended Culver Palms as she’s been bringing her dog there for years. My first visit with Dr. Sheriff to treat a perpetual ear infection(which my cat has a history of over the year) was great. She was warm, asked good questions, and was comprehensive. When the I ran out of meds earlier than the regimen required and the ear infection hadn’t improved, I brought the cat in for a recheck. Dr. Bergstrom was cold, lacked any bedside manner with both me and the cat, and used a tone that accused me of not properly treating my cat’s issue. He proceeded to mansplain in minute detail every step of the process of treatment including taking the med out of the fridge, warming it in your hand, and so on. He did the same about cleaning the ear. He made it clear that he thought I was lying or I’m incompetent. I’ve been successfully treating my cats ears for years and this is the first time I’ve had any issue with them not getting by better. He left it with referring me to a specialist -which is the right call-but continued to use a tone that blamed me as he did so. He displayed no curiosity about what might be going on and he seemed put off by my questions. As a pet owner who has seen dozens of vets and spent untold thousands on my pets in the last decade, I’ve never felt so disregarded and condescended. I’ll give CPAH another chance due to Dr. Sheriff but I will not see Dr. Bergstrom for any reason ever again.

A bit pricier than other vets I’ve gone to but I choose this vet because they’re patient with my anxious dogs and meet them at their level. My dogs respond so much better with these vets that I can’t imagine taking them elsewhere.

Very saddened about this place. Was going for almost two years and they didn't treat me right. They also cut my dog's ear while grooming and said it was her fault. So pathetic and not what a dog mom wants to hear. Had an emergency and they wouldn't even give me general advice, just told me to go to an ER or come in the next day.  No compassion, just a business to them. Had a few other bad experiences that have all added up and now it's time to find a new vet.
Everyone is so helpful and empathetic. My cat is relaxed and obedient with you all. Amazing. Thank you

From start to finish everyone has been so kind, helpful and patient with my family and pet. Whether it’s on the phone or in person, they are happy to answer my questions and concerns. I loved that the day after surgery the staff called to check on my cat :) what a compassionate group of people working here!
My kitten has received good service and care for reasonable prices here. Their customer service has been caring and generally excellent.

DO NOT GO HERE. We have been coming to this vet for 3+ years.  Dr Bergstrom ran the same tests over and over with no result. We saw a specialist who said dr bergstrom should have no problem performing a routine surgery yet now he refuses to do the surgery or even see the dog further. He had no problem taking our money but now that it’s time to do a needed and routine surgery, he refuses to do the surgery. He won’t even get on the phone to explain but has the lady at the front desk deliver the message. Take your dog to another vet because if something serious happens, this clinic will leave you on your own regardless of the history you have with them.

Update: We were presented with the option of an alternative surgeon to do the surgery our dog is needing since Dr. Bergstrom won’t do it.  We have been waiting for follow up to understand the option fully and were promised follow up this upcoming week. I just reached out to ask further questions however as a result of my honest review, Culver Palms is now retaliating and refusing to provide any further services for our dog.

TLDR; FIND ANOTHER CLINIC/VET to save your animal suffering, your time, and your money.

I am revisiting my previous review - which was extremely positive and 5 stars - to update and give other pet owners a warning. This clinic will present as if they care and will happily make appointments, prescribe meds, do rounds and rounds of repeat tests, exams, cultures, etc in order to take your money. However, when it comes to actually treating your animal and resolving issues, they will leave you and your beloved animal high and dry. After multiple years of being patrons here, paying for their wellness plans, and trusting their care (despite reoccurring and ongoing issues they continually failed to resolve), the vet we've been seeing most consistently - Dr. Bergstrom - has decided he is not comfortable continuing to treat our sweet girl and is simply leaving us with no reasonable option to heal her, other than recommending we have to spend an exorbitant amount of money for a standard procedure that he can perform. Despite spending THOUSANDS and THOUSANDS of dollars treating the same issue on repeat, he's now abandoning our dog while also knowing we are expecting our first child in about a month. To say that I am disappointed doesn't even begin to describe how we are feeling at this point.

If you take nothing else away from this review, let it be this: FIND ANOTHER CLINIC/VET to save your animal suffering, your time, and your money.
Very clean, professional and friendly
They were very welcoming and very customer service friendly, and have taken wonderful care of my dog.

I left a review for Culver Palms about 3 months ago because of their lack of care towards my dog’s treatments. I left the review in hopes of finding a solution with them, so I could continue to bring my dog in for care. Instead, they said …

It was a wonderful experience after a harrowing day of worry that escalated to an ER visit the night before. They were super busy but the front desk, tech and veterinarian were friendly, professional, and knowledgeable.  I feel that my Daisy is in good hands.

This was me and my girlfriend's first experience at CPAH and it's safe to say that we will be making this our go to Vet clinic. The vet and vet techs were really helpful, knowledgeable, and kind. They educated us on cost effective methods to make sure our cat stays happy and healthy!

The attention and care Ollie recieved from drop off to pick up was nothing short of amazing. The follow up phone calls completely eased my mind during his procedure. Thank you so much for taking such good care of my sweet boy 🧡 …

I am grateful to have CPAH near me. They took care both of my fur babies. Yes, I meant that in past tense . On June 6th of this year I was faced with the fact that I had to make a decision about my baby girl Bridgette. Bridgette was my …
